sources.quote: And Chisone is conditional, the cracking 8D on their 6082 material is still open.

findings.why: Meccanica Chisone has a conditional qualification, so it cannot receive new parts now. The only evidence is the 2026-10-02 meeting minutes. No later document shows the status has changed.

sources.quote: Chisone is qualified for 6061-T6 and 6082-T5 only. BR-220 is drawn in 6082-T6, yield at least 250.
Meccanica Chisone told me on the phone they can make BR-220 blanks from the same alloy they use for BR-310

findings.why: The BR-220 drawing requires 6082-T6, and Chisone is qualified only for 6061-T6 and 6082-T5. The 'same alloy as BR-310' claim is an unverified phone statement. It does not name a grade or temper, so it does not show 6082-T6 capability.

findings.key: cracking 8D on SUP-C 6082 material (issue id not given in documents)

sources.quote: the cracking 8D on their 6082 material is still open.

findings.why: Chisone has an open quality issue on 6082 material, which is the alloy BR-220 is drawn in. The issue id is not in the documents. The only closed 8D, 8D-25-019, belongs to SUP-B and is not relevant.

sources.quote: Rejected. No temporary source for BR-220 without 6082-T6 capability and a closed 8D.

findings.why: No controlled record covers SUP-C for BR-220 at the receiving plant and customer. The documents do not give the customer of BR-220. Absence of approval cannot be read as 'not approved', so a person must confirm whether a current source release exists. DEV-127, the earlier deviation request for the same change, was rejected, and nothing newer replaces that decision.
